questions.question:
Select the appropriate idiom that can replace the underlined phrase in the following sentence.

Geet __talks incessantly__ about cycling in her town.

options.text: has a bee in her bonnet

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**has a bee in her bonnet"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Talks incessantly" describes someone who constantly, or without stopping, talks about a particular thing. (लगातार बात करना) 
 
• "**Has a bee in her bonnet"** is an idiom that means someone is obsessed with something and talks about it constantly. 
 
 
• **Example**- She always has a bee in her bonnet about cleanliness.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• "**Put a bee on someone**" means to try to obtain money from, as for a loan or donation.(ऋण या दान के रूप में धन प्राप्त करने का प्रयास करना)
 
• "**Gives a buzz"** typically means to call someone on the phone. Its meaning in the Devanagari script is (किसी को फ़ोन करना).
 
• "**Makes a bee line**" means to head straight for something. Its meaning in Devanagari script is (सीधा जाना).

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks in the given sentence.

The vice chancellor is supposed to ________ the gathering tonight, and Seema was late as she could not find the ________ of Geeta.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option (2)**. i.e. **'address'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• In the context of the given sentence, the **1st blank** implies that the vice chancellor is supposed to deliver a speech to the gathering. The** 2nd blank** implies that she could not find the location.
 
• We can use **‘Address’** as a **verb **as well as a **noun**.
 
 
• **Address** (महत्वपूर्ण भाषण देना) as a **verb **means to deliver an important speech to an audience especially to give them information or instructions.
 
 
• **Example**: The manager will **address** the employees about the new company policies at the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Address** (पता) - as a **noun **means the particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated.
 
 
• **Example:** His **address **is 123 Main Street.
 
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct and complete sentence is *The vice chancellor is supposed to **address **__the gathering tonight, and Seema was late as she could not find the __address__ of Geeta.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

 
• **Speak **(बोलना) - To express thoughts, feelings, or information through words.

 
 
• **Example:** I can speak English fluently.
 
 
 
• **Convey **(व्यक्त करना) - To communicate or express information, feelings, or thoughts.
 
 
• **Example:** She used gestures to convey her message when she couldn't speak.
 
 
 
• **Home** (घर) - A place where one lives; a residence.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

We are (last) ________ in line.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is “**foremost**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

• "**Last**" implies being at the end or at the lowest position. (अंतिम)

 
 
• **Example**- He was the last person to arrive at the meeting.
 
 
 
• "**Foremost**" means being the most prominent in rank, importance, or position which is the exact opposite of last. (सबसे अग्रणी)
 
 
• **Example**- She was the foremost authority on pediatric medicine.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word is 'foremost’.

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 3**’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• "**Eventual**" means occurring or existing at the end of a process or period. (अंततः)
 
• "**Further**" implies a greater distance or time. (और आगे)
 
• "**Maimed**" means to have been injured in a way that permanently affects one's appearance or mobility. (अंगविकल होना).
